title: TypeScript packages: Databricks SDK 0.18 requires Node 22, so engines and the README Node requirement must be raised together
answers: Why does npm install of @mlflow/core fail with an engine error on Node 20?
What Node.js version does the MLflow TypeScript SDK require after the Databricks SDK upgrade?
Where do I change the minimum Node version for the TypeScript tracing packages?
Which package.json files must change when raising the minimum Node version?
body:
Path: The TypeScript tracing SDK in libs/typescript/core and its integrations (anthropic, claude-code, codex, gemini, openai, openclaw, opencode, qwen-code, vercel) declare the minimum runtime in each package.json `engines.node` field; libs/typescript/README.md states the same requirement to users.
Rule: Upgrading @databricks/sdk-experimental to 0.18.0 raises its runtime requirement to Node >=22, so the `engines.node` of every TypeScript package and the README note were set to >=22 together. Keep these in sync when the minimum Node version changes; do not bump only one package.
Symptom: Users on Node 18 or 20 installing @mlflow/core after the bump get an engine-incompatible dependency warning or failure, because the transitive dependency now requires Node 22 while the package claimed >=18.
Constraints: The reviewer flagged that this drops support for Node 20 and 18, which the earlier README advertised; any further change to the minimum version should be checked against the transitive Databricks SDK engines in package-lock.json.
applies: Minimum Node.js version declared for the TypeScript MLflow packages; not for Python or the MLflow server.
says: Installing the JavaScript tracing library fails with an unsupported runtime version error.
Users on older long term support runtimes cannot install the tracing packages anymore.
The installation guide documentation contradicts the actual minimum runtime version required by packages.
Raise the stated minimum environment version across all client integration packages and documentation.
Package installation shows engine mismatch warnings due to an upgraded vendor dependency.
search: When upgrading @databricks/sdk-experimental to 0.18.0, the minimum Node requirement increases to Node >=22, requiring the engines.node field across all TypeScript packages and the libs/typescript/README.md documentation to be raised together. This synchronization applies to libs/typescript/core and its integrations (anthropic, claude-code, codex, gemini, openai, openclaw, opencode, qwen-code, vercel), but does not apply to Python packages or the MLflow server. Dropping support for Node 18 and Node 20 prevents engine-incompatible dependency warnings during installation, and future version changes must be verified against transitive Databricks SDK engines in package-lock.json.
